theorem.name: COUPLED_COMPONENT_MESSAGE_COMPILATION_V1
theorem.scope: Any connected final residual Y0 component C with nonempty dynamic complete-neighbor set D_C in a P7-free source-valid state satisfying the frozen component-uniformity axioms.
exact_semantics: Residual Y0 is anticomplete to the current seed, so dynamic seed colors do not remove colors from C.
Precolored X0 vertices may be mixed on C; absorb them exactly into vertex-specific fixed base lists B_C(u)=[4]\f(N(u)∩X0).
Axiom (iv) implies every dynamic outside vertex outside Y0∪X0 is complete or anticomplete to connected C.
Therefore, for an outside coloring c, all dynamic influence on C is exactly the set F_C(c) of colors used by dynamic vertices complete to C.
Thus mu_C(F)=1 iff G[C] has a proper list-coloring from L_F(u)=B_C(u)\F.
list3_reduction: If D_C is nonempty, every reachable F_C(c) is nonempty.
For every nonempty F, every L_F(u) is contained in [4]\F, whose global size is at most 3.
G[C] is induced in the ambient P7-free graph, hence is P7-free.
Relabel [4]\F to at most three canonical colors and call the constructive P7-free List-3-Coloring algorithm.
At most 15 calls evaluate mu_C(F) for all nonempty masks F.
branch_logic: If every nonempty F has mu_C(F)=0, then no reachable outside coloring can extend through C because every reachable F is nonempty; return exact branch UNSAT.
If some nonempty F has mu_C(F)=1, monotonicity gives mu_C(empty)=1, so the full 16-entry table is then known.
theorem.monotonicity: If F subseteq F' and mu_C(F')=1, the same coloring witnesses mu_C(F)=1.
theorem.witness_storage: Store one explicit component coloring for each allowed nonempty mask. There are at most 15 masks; since residual components are disjoint, total witness storage over all components is polynomial.
theorem.lifecycle: 15 calls per coupled component to a polynomial constructive backend plus O(1)-mask bookkeeping; hence total compilation over all residual components is polynomial.

finite_semantic_language.good_masks: The good masks {F:mu_C(F)=1} form a down-set of the Boolean lattice 2^[4].
finite_semantic_language.justification: There are exactly 168 down-sets / monotone Boolean functions on four variables (Dedekind number M(4)); the repository finite checker independently enumerates this count.
finite_semantic_language.bad_masks: The bad masks form an upset.
finite_semantic_language.MIN_BAD: The inclusion-minimal bad masks form an antichain.
finite_semantic_language.justification_min_bad: By Sperner's theorem for 2^[4], every antichain has size at most binomial(4,2)=6; independently confirmed by the finite checker.
finite_semantic_language.exact_constraint: For every M in MIN_BAD(C), a legal outside coloring must satisfy M not subseteq F_C(c), equivalently at least one color in M is absent from colors used on D_C.

constructive_backend.source: Bonomo-Chudnovsky-Maceli-Schaudt-Stein-Zhong, Three-coloring and list three-coloring of graphs without induced paths on seven vertices
constructive_backend.imported_fact: P7-free List-3-Coloring is polynomial-time solvable and returns an explicit coloring if one exists.
constructive_backend.role: Used only on nonempty F, where the global remaining palette has size at most three.

exact_limits: This theorem does not solve uncoupled components D_C=empty; only F=empty is reachable there, which would be a four-color/list-four subproblem.
This theorem does not imply tractable joint composition of many component messages.
The 168-type bound is an alphabet bound, not a bound on the number of components or global assignments.
No claim that every one of the 168 types is source-realizable.
No full L2 repair or Lemma11 P7 lift.
